title: Deadeye
text:
Deadeye is an Ascendancy class for the Ranger.


== Overview ==
The Deadeye is a class focused around ranged offense. She can make her projectile skills more effective by giving them more damage at close or far range and adding an extra projectile. The Deadeye can also gain access to Tailwind, which improves her speed, evasion, and deflection amount as long as she avoids taking damage, or improve her frenzy charge generation and consumption. The Deadeye can also specialize in marks by learning Called Shots to autonomously apply marks on enemies or Bullseye to apply Critical Weakness to marked enemies. She can also summon mirages that fire more projectiles with Mirage Deadeye.
